title: Descendants of the Sun
overview: An official Indonesian remake of South Korea's drama series with the same title.

title: Oki & Nirmala
overview: Set in a magical fairytale land, this story follows the adventures of Oki—a cheerful yet clumsy ten-year-old green dwarf—and Nirmala, a graceful and kind-hearted forest fairy whose magic wand is always ready to help.

title: Gatto
overview: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, a scrappy black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, a ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose — unless Venice gets the better of him first.

title: Fish in a Barrel
overview: A group of friends devise a plan to avoid the workforce after graduating college. This plan however, could be detrimental to their lives.

title: Justice Hearts
overview: The solo origin story of the American-Korean actor Lewis Cosgrove. But Lewis Cosgrove is an American born raised western boy who has Korean heritage, but does not have Korean blood, his DNA comes from his American blood. The story will begin with the 13 year old Lewis Cosgrove in 2016.

title: Aafreen Manzil
overview: Aafreen Manzil follows a day in the life of Aafreen, set in Bengaluru, India, in 2004. What begins as an ordinary day becomes a turning point. As hours pass, she is forced to face a truth she has long suppressed. Pushed to a reckoning, she finds the courage to take a step toward reclaiming her life.

title: Threnodia
overview: A runaway couple takes on a journey of love, subconsciousness, and remorse; while believing that a homeless gay man is God.

title: The Last Days of Napoléon
overview: It is a farewell story that focuses on the absolute loneliness Napoleon Bonaparte experienced during the final days of his life after being exiled to the island of Saint Helena, and his deep longing for his homeland.

title: Wolf Creek: Legacy
overview: A family of American tourists wander innocently into Taylor's hunting grounds. When the parents sacrifice themselves to save their children, the kids find themselves alone, lost and hunted in the vast Australian wilderness.

title: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova
overview: Features several new human characters alongside the beloved and iconic Titans Godzilla and Kong as they face off against a cataclysmic world-ending threat.

title: Cry to Heaven
overview: Set in 18th-century Venice, the paths of two unlikely collaborators: a Venetian noble and a castrated singer from Calabria, both tries to succeed in the world of the opera.

title: Barbie and Ken
overview: When an unexpected glitch in the digital world threatens to delete their entire neighborhood, Barbie and Ken must team up with an eclectic crew of local characters to find the "Master Code" before their world goes permanently offline.
